instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/coin.brd` is the board to panelize. Create six prefixed copies of its element set and save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/coin_panel.brd`. Requirements: 1. The file must be valid XML. 2. The total element count must equal 6 times the original element count in `/home/user/Desktop/coin.brd`. 3. Every element refdes must start with a cell prefix matching `^[A-Z]\d+_`. 4. All six prefixes `A1_`, `A2_`, `A3_`, `B1_`, `B2_`, and `B3_` must appear. 5. Each prefix must cover the same number of elements as the original board. 6. All refdes must be unique across the panel. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
